conformant_adapter: GKOS-Engine-Lite Rust, pin-bound and not a GKX authority

identity.lineage_id: null unless supplied by a canonical GKX profile or projection
identity.chunk_id_digest: sha256 of RFC8785-compatible canonical JSON fields contract, chunker, source_id, structural_position, part_ordinal, content_digest

record_atomicity: all chunks sharing source_id must bind identical source path/digest, metadata/sensitivity, lineage, validity, and relationship envelopes; any mismatch rejects the generation; discoverability decisions are uniform per source
phase_1_relationship_disclosure: supersedes, superseded_by, and MOC target identifiers are suppressed from search result chunks until an authorized endpoint resolver is available
timestamp_filter_grammar: existing GKX_TIMESTAMP_RE: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with optional seconds/fraction and mandatory Z or numeric plus/minus HH:MM offset; parsed date must exist
trusted_config_lexical_profile: gkos-toml-subset/1; exact accepted/rejected forms and canonical document digests are pinned in gkos-toml-lexical-fixture.json
path_glob_filters: memoized Unicode-code-point matching: ? matches one non-slash Unicode scalar, * matches zero or more non-slash scalars, ** matches zero or more scalars including slash; the entire path must match

canonical_json.numbers: JSON.stringify-compatible finite binary64 rendering; negative zero becomes zero; integer-valued numbers outside plus/minus (2^53-1) are rejected
canonical_json.strings: no Unicode normalization; unpaired UTF-16 surrogates are rejected
canonical_json.data_model: dense arrays and plain enumerable own-string-key data objects only; undefined, accessors, symbols, cycles, sparse arrays, and exotic objects are rejected

rrf.duplicate_collapse: first occurrence per stage by chunk_id

mmr.relevance: fusion_score/max_fusion_score, or reciprocal reranker rank when reranking is active

stage_scores.lexical_score: NFD/mark-stripped lowercase Unicode letter/number/private-use query-token substring frequency divided by sqrt(token_count+1); Greek final sigma folds to ordinary sigma, punctuation including underscore/hyphen separates unquoted terms; weights title=3, heading_path=2, tags=1.5, topic=2, category=2, text=1

confidence_zero_signal: a rank-one candidate whose lexical, semantic, and reranker signals are all absent or non-positive is low confidence with WEAK_LEXICAL_MATCH; rank alone never creates high confidence

lexical_backends.selection: probe the actual bundled SQLite virtual-table capability; never infer from Node version
lexical_backends.preferred: sqlite_fts5 when a real FTS5 virtual-table create/drop probe succeeds
lexical_backends.compatibility: sqlite_lexical_scan when the runtime has no FTS5 module; ordinary SQLite joins the policy-eligible ID set before deterministic in-process clause matching and scoring
lexical_backends.scan_candidate_rule: gkos-unicode61-subset-scan/1 uses the host runtime Unicode property tables for letters, numbers, and private-use Co; applies diacritic folding only to Latin-base clusters; folds Greek final sigma to sigma; preserves non-Latin canonical-form distinctions; and treats underscore/hyphen and other punctuation as separators; each normalized clause must occur as one consecutive token sequence within one indexed field; distinct clauses may match distinct fields
lexical_backends.query_grammar: one or more space/Unicode-whitespace-delimited terms or complete double-quoted phrases; C0/DEL controls (including NUL), unmatched/embedded quotes, empty phrases, and clauses containing no compatibility-subset token are rejected before corpus or store access
lexical_backends.manifest_binding: lexical_backend is required in projection schema 2 and participates in projection_digest and projection_id
lexical_backends.reporting: sqlite_lexical_scan is state degraded with SQLITE_LEXICAL_SCAN_ACTIVE, SQLITE_LEXICAL_SCAN_APPROXIMATION, and, when applicable, SQLITE_FTS5_UNAVAILABLE; it is never advertised as FTS5
lexical_backends.parity_scope: fixed phrase, punctuation, hyphen, underscore, private-use, Latin diacritic/combining-mark, Greek/Hangul canonical-form distinction, Greek sigma folding, cross-field, substring, no-match, ordering, score, and citation fixtures; exhaustive Unicode-6.1 parity outside that frozen corpus is not claimed

parent_expansion: only when the winning child has fewer than the configured token threshold (default 80, valid 1..4096): nearest structural ancestor's first chunk; winning citation remains unchanged
parent_authorization: parent independently passes the same discoverability policy and typed filters; otherwise omitted
citations: live source digest, exact indexed byte slice, and absolute one-based LF/CRLF line coordinates are recomputed and verified before ranking; stale/forged eligible chunks do not score; returned citations set verified=true and stale=false; unquoted punctuation-separated terms cite exact component spans; a quoted phrase cites the exact phrase when present and otherwise exact component-token spans, never an invented phrase quotation
overlap_result_dedup: process final ranked candidates in order; hits with matched spans retain only unclaimed exact (source_id,start_byte,end_byte) spans and are skipped if none remain; hits with no matched spans are skipped when their half-open chunk interval overlaps any accepted interval from the same source; adjacent intervals do not overlap; only accepted hits claim spans/intervals
eligible_result_count: authorized, typed-filtered, live-verified chunks in the eligible corpus before matching and scoring
result_text_budget: counts returned winning chunk text plus optional parent text; a winner that fits is retained and its optional parent is omitted when the parent would exceed the remaining budget; a winner is skipped only when its own text cannot fit

provider_routing.embedding_space_mismatch: hard VECTOR_SPACE_MISMATCH_REBUILD_REQUIRED error before provider invocation
provider_routing.embedding_failure: reported lexical-only degradation using the manifest-bound active lexical backend

embedding_cache: reuse only from the verified active vault-local generation by exact (provider_id, model_id, dimensions, content_digest); missing, corrupt, or mismatched prior state is a cache miss; publication remains all-vectors-or-none
trusted_config_discovery: current working directory only with explicit trust
explicitly designated workspace root or automatically discovered workspace only when outside the vault
untrusted_vault_config: may contain only bounded retrieval preferences; cannot select endpoints, tokens, model/executable paths, credentials, service binding, or policy
